hero.headline: Reaching the World with the Light of Christ's Kingdom
hero.subheadline: Sharing the light of Jesus Christ through biblical teaching, worship, prayer, and fellowship across the nations.

mission.body: Illumination Global Ministries exists to proclaim the gospel of Jesus Christ and encourage people everywhere to grow in the truth, hope, and power of His Kingdom.

services.headline: All Are Welcome
services.subtext: No matter where you are on your journey, there is a place for you here.

prayer.body: Whatever you're facing, you don't have to face it alone. Submit a prayer request and our team will stand in agreement with you.
